evals.prompt: Our app is portrait-only and phone-shaped. We're moving to targetSdk 36. What has to change for tablets and foldables?
evals.expected_output: An adaptive layout plan explaining that orientation and resizability restrictions are ignored on large screens for targetSdk 36, with layouts per width class, navigation changes, state preservation and a test matrix.
expectations: States the Android 16 large-screen behavior change
Uses the official width breakpoints 600, 840, 1200, 1600 dp
Switches navigation bar to rail at medium width or larger
Includes state preservation across folding and resizing
Recommends the official android/skills adaptive skill for implementation
